component.name: Matt|Pic
component.summary: Sort and touch up photos quickly

description.p: Matt|Pic is a fast photo organizer in the spirit of the classic Picasa: browse folders, rate with stars, make quick corrections and export.

ul.li: Originals are never changed – edits are applied only on export
Star ratings, moving and trash with undo
Quick corrections: crop, rotate, light, colour
EXIF details incl. drone flight data, videos and RAW previews
Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese and German

description.p: Windows version (MSI installer). First window fits small screens.
Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese and German (follows the system language, can be changed under Help).
